say:1:1730158501:1.text: I don't know the truth, but I've heard plenty of speculation about it!
say:1:1730158501:1.source_cn: 我虽然不知道，但我听说了不少圣古堂的不少八卦！
say:1:1730158501:1.male: I don't know the truth, but I've heard plenty of speculation about it!
say:1:1730158501:1.female: I don't know the truth, but I've heard plenty of speculation about it!

say:2:1730158502:1.text: As usual, you buy a paper, and I'll tell you what I know.
say:2:1730158502:1.source_cn: 老规矩，一份报纸兑换圣古堂的八卦，童叟无欺。

say:4:1730158503:1.text: Cheers! *Cough* So, here's what I've got on the chapel.
say:4:1730158503:1.source_cn: 多谢惠顾！咳咳，以下是圣古堂的八卦汇总！

say:5:1730158504:1.text: Some suspect the Bantus is behind it, yet it has remained silent so far.
say:5:1730158504:1.source_cn: 有人猜测这次圣古堂消失是班题斯的阴谋……不过截止目前班...
say:5:1730158504:1.male: Some suspect the Bantus is behind it, yet it has remained silent so far.
say:5:1730158504:1.female: Some suspect the Bantus is behind it, yet it has remained silent so far.

say:6:1730158505:1.text: And there are those who claim it's King Rolan's punishment for the Queen's regency.
say:6:1730158505:1.source_cn: 也有人在传这是罗兰大帝对王后摄政不满，从而降下的天罚！
